name: Estimate & Scheduler
description: Rapidly edit task estimates and schedule start times across all projects

changelog.1.5.0: Compatibility fix for SP's new typia runtime hook validation (persistedDataChanged hook name)
changelog.1.4.0: Filter bar overhaul (unified height/styling, Filter/Sort labels, project sort); show done tasks with strikethrough and ✅ column; subscribe to all task lifecycle hooks with debounce; persist UI state across sessions; date/time picker connected pills with business-day chips and Next Week button
changelog.1.3.0: Date/time picker overhaul: connected pill groups, remaining business days only with Next Week button, shortened time labels (Morn/Arvo), Clear Schedule button with cascade scope control; filter bar redesigned with Filter/Sort section labels, emoji restored, descriptive sort options, Scheduled — Latest First sort added
changelog.1.2.0: Subtask cascade scheduling (move subsequent or gap-close mode); scheduler UI with calendar overlay and freetext time parser (5pm, 3.30am); show time logged toggle; single-row filter/sort bar; estimate buttons 1h/15m/5m; smart estimate display (fixed width, drops minutes above 99h); scheduled row left border matches badge colour; scroll preserved across all interactions
changelog.1.1.0: Filter bar redesign (cycling emoji buttons), scheduled badge colour-coded by timing, Now button, CSS var cleanup, collapse state persistence, schedule time minute precision
changelog.1.0.0: Initial release — task estimate editing and schedule start time picker across all projects
